why: Şanlıurfa's and Diyarbakır's centre zones were enclaves in the rest of their provinces (T-3506): Şanlıurfa takes Siverek, Hilvan and Bozova (it then borders Adıyaman's and Bingöl's zones), Diyarbakır takes Çınar and Bismil (it then borders Mardin's and Batman's); the Siverek zone, left with the south and west, is named Nizip
